signIn.title: Sign in to connect an app
signIn.description: Sign in to Boardsesh, then choose what an app can see.

consent.title: Connect an app
consent.description: Choose whether an app can connect to your Boardsesh account.

invalidLink.title: This link doesn't work
invalidLink.body: Go back to the app you came from and connect again.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: A link to connect an app lasts 10 minutes. Go back to the app and connect again.

unavailable.title: Connecting apps isn't available right now
unavailable.body: Try again later. Your Boardsesh account isn't affected.

signedOut.title: Sign in to connect an app
signedOut.body: An app wants to connect to your Boardsesh account. Sign in first, and you'll see what it can access before anything is shared.

stale.title: Sign in again to continue
stale.body: Connecting an app needs a recent sign-in, so we're asking you to sign in once more. Your account is fine.
stale.detail: We ask every 30 days and after a password change.

justSignedIn.title: Almost there
justSignedIn.body: If you changed your password in the last minute, wait a minute, then sign in again.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in isn't working right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.accountNotLinked: That account belongs to a different Boardsesh sign-in. Sign in the way you first signed up, or sign out and try again.
errors.linkRefused: That account isn't linked to your Boardsesh sign-in yet. Sign in with your password or the account you usually use.

consent.loading: Checking what the app is asking for
consent.title: Connect {{app}} to your Boardsesh account?
consent.reconnect: You disconnected {{app}} before. Choosing Allow connects it again.

scopes.profileRead: See your display name and profile photo
scopes.logbookRead: See every tick in your logbook, on every board
scopes.logbookOnlyMe: Including ticks you keep to “Only me”
scopes.logbookUnlisted: Including other setters' unlisted climbs and drafts you've logged
scopes.logbookSpraywall: Climbs on someone else's Private or Link only Spraywall arrive without their names
scopes.offlineAccess: Keep this access until you disconnect it

consent.cannot: It can't change anything in your account, and it never sees your password.
consent.notReviewed: Boardsesh hasn't reviewed this app. Only connect apps you trust.
consent.redirect: After you choose, you go back to {{host}}.
consent.disconnect: You can disconnect it any time in Settings › Connected apps.

connected.title: {{app}} is connected
connected.body: Taking you back to {{app}}. If nothing happens, use the button below.

declined.title: {{app}} isn't connected
declined.body: Nothing was shared. Taking you back to {{app}}.

appFull.title: {{app}} can't take new connections right now
appFull.body: It has reached its limit for now, so nothing was shared. Try again later.

appNotReady.title: {{app}} can't connect yet
appNotReady.body: Its developer hasn't finished setting it up, so nothing was shared.

appError.title: {{app}} didn't connect
appError.body: Nothing was shared. Go back to {{app}} and try again.

appUnavailable.title: This app can't connect
appUnavailable.body: It isn't available on Boardsesh right now, so nothing was shared.

signInAgain.title: Sign in again to continue
signInAgain.body: Connecting an app needs a recent sign-in. Your account is fine.

busy.title: Boardsesh is busy
busy.body: Nothing was shared. Try again in a minute.

failed.title: That didn't work
failed.body: Nothing was shared. Try again, or go back to the app and connect again.
